title: Impermeable
summary: IMPER'MEABLE, adjective [Latin in and permeo; per and meo, to pass.] Not to be passed through the pores by a fluid; as impermeable leather.

inlines.v: IMPER'MEABLE, adjective [Latin in and permeo; per and meo, to pass.] Not to be passed through the pores by a fluid; as impermeable leather.
